title.narrative: Promoting energy efficiency technologies in beer brewery sector in Burkina Faso

description.narrative: The project aims at promoting the adoption of energy efficient industrial cook stoves in the beer brewing sector in Burkina Fasp. To overcome barriers to their introduction the project is adopting various tools. More specifically, as part of the first component the project supports multi stakeholder capacity building on the design, contruction and maintenance of the stoves. As part of the second component, the project works throughout the distribution and supply chain of the energy efficient cook stoves to create micro entreprise clusters in order to stimulate market demand. Finally, the project aims at achieving the market scale for improved cook stoves through upgrading the insitutional capacity to develop and implement programmes of activities to support the deployment of improved cook stoves through carbon financing and particularly though the voluntary carbon market.
